scope: Ordinary long-walk observations followed by two independent clean-idle reproductions on the exact sandbox-polish ROM. State corruption is observed; a stack/music-interrupt cause remains a hypothesis.

provenance.memoryInspection: Read-only selected diagnostic bytes; no state injection is claimed.
provenance.rawArtifacts: Original events, semantic observations and archive bytes remain locally ignored. Private paths and request tokens are omitted.

watchedMemory.scope: Addresses and original bytes belong to this exact ROM/NOI. Only the first 13 initialized packet bytes are invariant; the remaining 11 script bytes can legitimately change after a scene return. The complete original 24-byte packet is retained as an observation. These read-only samples are not a save export or evidence of a measured stack pointer.

runs.name: ordinary-long-walk

observations.finding: Unexpected flag value observed during ordinary play.
A genuine game-button soft reset restored the watched flag.
The grocery room opened successfully after that reset.

runs.limitation: The successful post-reset room entry does not repair the preceding corruption or establish final gameplay acceptance.

runs.name: clean-idle-reproduction

method.subsequentInputs: Neutral input in 120-frame sampling steps, without walking or opening a shop.

runs.finding: The invariant initialized prefix changed under clean stationary idle, independently of the long walk and shop entry. This is not merely a legal change to the script tail.

runs.name: refined-clean-idle-window
runs.finding: A separate clean boot narrows the first observed overwrite of the invariant initialized prefix to an eight-frame interval.

interpretation.confirmed: Reproducible native state corruption makes this exact ROM ineligible for selection, packaging or loading.
interpretation.stackReserveFinding: A 470-byte linked static reserve did not establish runtime memory safety for this workload.
interpretation.causeHypothesis: Deep native call-stack use combined with music interrupts may overwrite nearby state.
interpretation.repairStatus: This failed historical ROM retains its requires-fix result. A separate replacement ROM has compiled and passed scoped ordinary native validation; its evidence is recorded independently in NATIVE_SANDBOX_STABLE.json.

limitations: Read-only packet samples bracket the overwrite but do not identify the writing instruction, exact stack low-water mark or interrupt path.
Successful compilation, static graphics/memory checks and earlier scoped timing do not override this native failure.
Reset recovery and one grocery entry do not accept boats, shops in general, theft, pursuits, jet rendering, the campaign or physical cartridge behavior.
No physical write or hardware operation occurred in these diagnostics. The separately confirmed installed 9c155 baseline remains unchanged.
A repaired ROM needs new ordinary native reproduction, gameplay and hardware evidence; these records cannot be reassigned to it.

replacementEvidence.scope: Separate replacement observations do not change the original recordings, prove their precise corruption cause, or establish physical cartridge execution.
